title: A/R Collection does not remember expanded groups
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date in several customer groups.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Note which groups are expanded.
  2. Click the chevron on the first customer group row to change it.
  3. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  4. Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: note the report's opening state.
  • Step 2: that customer group changes (expands or collapses).
  • Step 3: Sales By Customer opens.
  • Step 4: A/R Collection opens in the same state as in step 1, not the state you left: the change is not remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R9: “Expanded state is not remembered between visits.”
